Poola Rangadu
Poola Rangadu is a 1967 Indian Telugu- language drama film, produced by D. Madhusudhana Rao under the Annapurna Pictures banner and directed by Adurthi Subba Rao. It stars Akkineni Nageswara Rao, Jamuna, Shobhan Babu, Vijaya Nirmala with music composed by Saluri Rajeswara Rao. The film was loosely based on A. J. Cronin's" Beyond This Place", which had earlier been adapted into the 1955 Bengali movie" Sabar Uparey" and the 1958 Hindi movie" Kala Pani". The film was remade in Kannada in 1968 as" Rowdy Ranganna", in Tamil in 1970 as" En Annan" and in Hindi in 1972 as" Jeet". The film was recorded as a" Super Hit" at the box office.
